item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Avni looks at the diagram of triangle $ABC$. Segment $AD$ meets side $BC$ at $D$, and the right-angle mark at $D$ is shown.

Which claim correctly names $AD$?

options.A: Call $AD$ an altitude even when $AD$ need not be perpendicular to $BC$.
options.B: Say the same segment also settles the area formula for every triangle, with no further check.
options.C: $AD$ is an altitude from $A$ to base $BC$, because it is perpendicular to $BC$.
options.D: Find $AD$ by using only that the three angles of triangle $ABC$ add to $180^{\circ}$.
